g.text: ONE brain (one network, one update loop): a NAVIGATION half and a CONVERSATION half as separate groups of neurons on the same substrate
they interact through three validated synaptic routes — A a spoken word steers the body · B navigate to SEE an object then RECALL it · C bind a PERCEIVED object into a new fact

navigation picks its move by a spiking race (no hand–coded shortcut) · conversation answers "I don't know" rather than inventing (no–confabulation safeguard) · honest map of the code, simplifications included
build_bg_brain_regions() · perception → action, learned by trial and reward
the decision heart · where it learns
DEFAULT: the move emerges from the race
reward cells → dopamine; error = reward − value
spiking actor–critic (all neural) • value subtracts via slow inhib.
one pool per direction — N / E / S / W (×4)
the body moves the way the firing pool says
SHARED • ⌂ the body acts on its output (legitimate)
the production pipeline (OneBrainComposer) · the language brain
similar words sit close (so it can generalize)
Composer — bind words into a fact
who / what · yes–no · multi–hop reasoning · multi–turn dialogue
answers "I don't know" rather than inventing
a learned familiarity gate · reconstruct fact → unbind roles → clean up
picks the next on–topic thing to say
a spiking "say–this–first" ranking orders the words
competitive–queuing serial order (not a host template)
→ words out / "I don't know" • ⌂ output boundary
